comment: regalia-kms-dx7.3 (docs/design/single-node.md 4.3): the self-issued runtime lease, as Python and Go both decide it.
Each case is a lease of `issuer` for `subject` under a manifest of `manifest` (v1: before topology, multi-node; v5-multi; v5-single),
or, where `issuer` is null, an admission document of `mode` only. tests/test_baremetal_lease.py (SelfIssued) signs each lease with
the issuer's AK and replays lease.verify (`lease`: accepted, or the refusal's words), derives the admission mode the lease
service writes (single when issuer == subject, else lease) and replays admission.mode_fits_profile; the Go reader
(internal/admission, self_lease_vector_test.go) replays modeFitsProfile on `mode` and `profile` and Parse on the document the
lease service writes in that mode. `fits`: whether the mode may serve under the profile.
